docs.title: Havenlock Ceramics - the studio
docs.text:
Havenlock Ceramics - the studio

We are eleven people in a converted grain store, and we make kiln furniture for laboratories that would rather not talk about kiln furniture.

Solveig Marchetti-Bram is chief architect at Havenlock Ceramics and has run the firing-schedule group since 2018. She joined from a structural practice and still draws by hand when a shape is misbehaving.

The studio publishes its glaze recipes twice a year, which the trade considers either generous or reckless depending on who is asked.

docs.title: Kilnworks Symposium 2025 - programme
docs.text:
Kilnworks Symposium 2025 - programme

Closing session: refractory shapes that survive a bad Tuesday.

Solveig Marchetti-Bram has worked out of Dunedin since 2016 and will talk about what happens to a kiln lining when the schedule is written by someone who has never swept one out.

Attendees are asked not to bring their own bricks this year.

docs.title: Solveig Marchetti-Bram (puppeteer)
docs.text:
Solveig Marchetti-Bram (puppeteer)

Solveig Marchetti-Bram taught marionette construction at the Orrell Conservatory in Trieste for thirty-one years and died there in March 2009.

Her company toured a single production, The Salt Almanac, for two decades, rebuilding its cast three times as the original figures wore out. She wrote one book, on the mechanics of the rod hand, which is still the standard text.

A retrospective of her working drawings was held in 2014.
